title: The in-progress forms list surfaces every wizard the operator has started but not yet submitted with a resume link back to the task-list
asA: operator returning to the application with more than one wizard on the go
iWant: an index surface listing every wizard I have started but not submitted, each with the wizard title, the step I was on and a resume link
soThat: I can walk back into the one I meant to finish without hunting through the navigation

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given at least one draft persisted per REQ-005, /in-progress renders [data-surface="in-progress-list"] with one [data-wizard-row] per draft carrying the wizard title, the step slug the operator was on and a [data-recovery="resume"] link whose href routes back to the wizard's task-list surface. The row count matches the number of drafts held in the draft store.

When the in-progress list read returns a non-2xx or times out, the surface renders the last cached list (if any) with a fetch-failed banner and an inline retry; drafts owned by other principals never appear in the list even on a stale cache.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a server-side draft list whose read returns a non-2xx or times out
acceptanceCriteria.then: the last cached list renders with a fetch-failed banner, an inline retry is keyboard-reachable and no cross-principal draft appears

acceptanceCriteria.description: A draft in the list is only shown to its owning principal; a request from another principal for the same draft id refuses at the applied auth boundary and never renders the draft on the list.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a draft owned by principal A and a request from principal B
acceptanceCriteria.when: the list surface renders for principal B
acceptanceCriteria.then: the draft is not present in the list and any direct URL for principal B refuses at the auth boundary
